Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the kickoff call this morning. We attached the redline to the MSA and a short CSV showing the PO metadata we require from vendor systems so our Ariba intake matches our ERP. Two items I want to flag up front: 1) our procurement team needs the PO to include vendor_tax_id + remit_bank_code as mandatory fields, and 2) we require a documented signatory chain (executive + procurement approver) for electronic signature to satisfy our audit.

Can Redwood confirm whether the Order Form will surface those PO fields to our Ariba connector and whether you can map your signers in DocuSign so routing follows: Redwood Legal -> PharmaSource Procurement -> PharmaSource CFO? We're on a tight schedule — go-live for PO issuance is 2027-08-03.

Attachments: PharmaSource_MSA_redline_20270726.docx (track changes), requested-po-fields.csv

Appreciate a quick note on next steps and who to loop in from your side for legal sign-off.

Best,
Karen
Head of Procurement, PharmaSource Inc.

Karen —

Thanks, received the redline and CSV. Quick confirmations and proposed plan: 1) Redwood can expose custom metadata to Ariba/Coupa through our Order Form adapter; we will map vendor_tax_id and remit_bank_code as required fields in the connector. I do need to confirm whether PharmaSource wants those required on submission or only validated post-submission (we can do either; required-on-submission changes the UI slightly).

2) For e-sign routing — we use DocuSign and can configure the signer matrix you described. Legal prefers one minor language tweak in the MSA (section 5.2) to avoid double-signature liabilities; I'll route that to Markus and Marissa for sign-off.

Proposed next steps:
- Markus: quick legal triage of the redline and call out any non-starters.
- Marissa: ops mapping for Ariba adapter (I copied a sample CSV in attachments).
- Karen / ProcureOps: confirm whether vendor_tax_id & remit_bank_code must be enforced at submission.

We aim to get an agreed redline + DocuSign envelope ready by EOD 2027-07-27 to meet your 08/03 go-live. If we need an exception to PO-ack SLA for the first week of issuance while mappings stabilize, let us know and we can build an interim routing policy.

Attachments: redline-summary-PS-20270726.pdf

Thanks — Stephanie

Team —

I reviewed the attached MSA redline. High level: PharmaSource's edits are mostly operational and acceptable; the only clause that needs negotiation is section 5.2 (indemnity scope) and one data-flow sentence around caching of invoice metadata that could impact telemetry retention. I marked preferred language in the attached doc and summarized the non-starters.

Proposed legal response (short):
- Accept operational field requirements (vendor_tax_id, remit_bank_code) — we will map and expose them.
- Counter: limit indemnity exposure to direct damages and clarify no caching of invoice payload beyond 30 days unless explicitly requested.
- Signatory routing: DocuSign routing is fine — legal requests that the envelope include roles (Legal Reviewer, Procurement Reviewer, CFO) and that a copy of final executed MSA be pushed to PharmaSource's supplier record URL (we can automate via webhook).

Marissa — can you confirm the Ariba adapter accepts a vendor_tax_id column named TAX_ID and remit_bank_code named REMIT_BIC? If not we need a short mapping table tomorrow.

Attachment: redline-summary-PS-20270726.pdf

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
